comparator.sourceNotes: The corrected Chemistry pathway closes 60+60+60 with 82.5 EC compulsory study, 52.5 EC restricted choice and 45 EC genuine profiling. Biochemical Methods/Academic Formation 2 is compulsory; Inorganic/Solid-State Chemistry is selected, not universal. The bounded set includes the required Category 2 choice and satisfies the stronger formal level minima. Extra chemistry examples are not used to erase genuine profiling. The dated 2025-entry page is context only. Formal and current required/advanced-course evidence support Dutch plus English.

The concrete pathway uses a coherent set of published materials, physical, inorganic, analytical and supporting-methods courses while satisfying the displayed category structure.
